item.title: Flickbar 0.10.0
item.description:
### What's new
- **Touch and hold works on a real trackpad.** Resting two fingers on a title bar now opens the layout grid. Before, it only worked in testing, because a resting hand sends a different signal than the test did. - **Gesture tutorial.** After you grant access, Flickbar offers a practice window that ticks off each main gesture as you do it. Open it again any time with *Gesture Tutorial…* in the menu. - **Updates inside the app.** Choose *Check for Updates…* in the menu, or turn on daily checks in Settings (off unless you turn it on). Updates are signed, and Flickbar installs only those that match its key. Homebrew users can keep using `brew upgrade`. - **New icon.** Rebuilt in Apple's Icon Composer, so it gets the Liquid Glass look on macOS 26 and later.
